$comment: S-103: the App Privacy (App Store Connect) and Data safety (Google Play) answers for the courier app, entered by hand in each console (neither has an API for them). Keep equal to the privacy manifest in app.config.ts — the release check compares them. docs/runbooks/mobile-release.md § Privacy answers.

serviceProviders.name: Apple Push Notification service, Firebase Cloud Messaging
serviceProviders.why: "New run" and "Run changed" notifications: the push token, the words, a link and ids (docs/runbooks/push.md).

accountDeletion.status: courier accounts are created by Northline, not in the app (5.1.1(v) covers apps that create accounts); a courier deletes the account on the consumer site's Your data page (S-105)
accountDeletion.webOnlyDecision: Owner decision 2026-10-04 (docs/DECISIONS.md): courier account deletion is on the website; the app links to it. Revisit only if App Review asks.

PreciseLocation.why: While a run is open, also in the background (a visible notification on Android): customers follow their order. Only the latest position is kept, never a history.

PhotosorVideos.why: The photo at the door as proof of delivery (one of three proofs).

UserID.why: The courier's account id behind every call.

DeviceID.why: The push token and a random installation id (never a hardware id), only when notifications are allowed.

OtherUserContent.why: The customer's signature at the door (one of three proofs) and pickup notes.

notCollected: Name, email or phone (the courier signs in on Northline's site; the app does not send them)
